title: CMake Now Speaks SYCL
subtitle: SYCL is now supported as a native CMake language (experimental and opt-in in CMake 4.5), cutting the custom build logic each project has had to maintain and working across AdaptiveCpp, upstream Clang, and both DPC++ distributions. A new SYCLAcademy lesson walks through the CMake workflow, and SYCL 2020 Revision 13 adds split headers that can reduce compile times.
